rules.title: Security scan: gitleaks and zizmor through the shared workflow
CI and Sonar through the shared workflow of the repository's stack
No Sonar scanner step outside krizaka/.github (the shared jobs own it)
OpenSSF Scorecard workflow
Dependabot configuration
Dependabot auto-merge through the shared workflow

Visual regression of the app's journeys (shared workflow): it warns on a pull request, with the diff published on Bunny, and blocks only the release to production (rules review 2026-11-05, krizaka/.github#538)
AGENTS.md carries the anti-slop section (template section 9)
The agents' edit hook (krizaka-edit-check) in .claude/settings.json
A @krizaka release reaches the consumer: the bump workflow exists and the bump landed (no @krizaka/* pin behind a version out for 3 days)
The Java family is current: krizaka-parent and krizaka-bom are not behind a krizaka-build release out for 3 days
pnpm workspaces: no workspace: range leaves the repository
Expo apps: the SDK builds with the App Store's Xcode (check-expo-sdk)
Every public form with a Turnstile widget verifies the token server-side (fail closed)
Public e-mail forms verify the address before anything is delivered (a mailed code or a confirmation link)

No departed product is mentioned (the products that left the org on 2026-10-29: the org holds Yomizaka, Akinaza, Orazaka, Kachizaka — the managed storage's code name, recycled 2026-10-31 — and the platforms)
No published package carries a departed product (the latest npm tarball of every public package, built CSS/JS included, never names one)

No code name on a public surface or in a public URL: the screens, the catalogues, the built HTML, the sitemap, llms.txt and every public link say the commercial name (Verikora, Folioviv, Sovkora, Kridoc) and the commercial www domain; the code names stay in repositories, packages, coordinates and the CLI (réunion 6, 2026-11-05)
Nothing outside the lab depends on the lab (krizaka-lab publishes nothing; a proven piece is promoted by an ADR, never imported)
Code rules in the lint ratchet: braces always, max-depth 2, max-nested-callbacks 3, no console in runtime (@krizaka/config krizakaCodeRules, code/<rule> counters)
ast-grep code rules in the sg ratchet: no-sync-fs-in-runtime, no-hand-written-validation-regex (@krizaka/config ast-grep core)
« Done » covers every surface: the feature issue template has the Surfaces checklist and the repository calls the closing check (feature-surfaces.yml)
Prettier with @krizaka/config/prettier in every TS/JS repository: config, format and format:check scripts, checked in CI (google-java-format stays for Java)
AGENTS.md is the org template (docs/standards/agents-template.md): purpose, profile, commands, the 10 rules, the krizaka-engineering skill; at most 80 lines, links resolve
The product's critical journeys run on every PR and merge group (journeys / gate, required on main) and after every deploy, dev and prod (post-deploy-journeys)
Every repository tests the merged result: a merge queue on main, or branch protection that requires branches up to date (strict)

The checks required on main match the repository profile: apps CI gate, Sonar (blocking a pull request only on its Security rating, krizaka/.github#542), security scan, journeys gate where it has journeys; libraries CI gate, Sonar, security scan. Visual regression is not a required check of a pull request: it blocks the release only (rules review 2026-11-05)
Conflict resolutions are checked: a PR that drops more than 50 lines main added meanwhile, or deletes generated content, fails without a `deletion-explained:` line
Fail-closed ast-grep rules in the sg ratchet: no-fail-open-secret, no-bare-skip, no-unchecked-sent-log, no-swallowed-catch-success (@krizaka/config ast-grep core; a check never passes without proof)
Time limits everywhere: timeout-minutes on every workflow job, a per-test timeout (2 min default) in every test runner config - better to fail and calibrate than to run in the void
Every required check of main reports in a merge_group run: its workflow triggers on merge_group, and an app check like SonarCloud has a CI scan job
Rust is tool-checked, not reviewed: rustfmt, clippy (pedantic, ratcheted per lint in lang-ratchet.json), cargo-deny (advisories, licences, bans) and timed tests through rust-quality.yml

Python is tool-checked, not reviewed: ruff (bugbear, bandit), pyright, import-linter, pip-audit, deptry (ratcheted per rule in lang-ratchet.json) through python-quality.yml; pytest runs with pytest-timeout

The overall SonarCloud counts may only go down, but only the security counts (vulnerabilities, hotspots to review) block; bugs and smells rising is a warning (rules review 2026-11-05: Sonar blocks only on the Security rating): sonar-ratchet.json at the root, checked after the scan by actions/sonar-ratchet
No workflow opens an issue in the repository it runs in (our alerts live in the private krizaka-internal: actions/alert-issue, app token)
No founder name on a public page: « fondée à Montréal »; his signature stays on the blog only (réunion 6, 2026-11-05)
No money amount in public words: no price, no « à partir de », no « sur devis » on the public pages and the code-name sites (founder 2026-11-03, réunion 6)

The code-name hosts (www.yomizaka.com, www.akinaza.com, www.orazaka.com, dev.<code>.com) are noindex: robots Disallow and X-Robots-Tag noindex, proven by the app's indexing test (réunion 6, 2026-11-05)
Every privacy page names the Law 25 person in charge (the role, no personal name) and confidentialite@krizaka.com (réunion 6, 2026-11-05)
One public status per product, the same word everywhere and equal to krizaka.com's: « En développement » Verikora and Sovkora, « En pause » Folioviv, « En conception » Kridoc (réunion 6, 2026-11-05)
One contact path: « Nous écrire » / « Write to us » leads to krizaka.com/{fr|en}/contact with the topic and the source site (réunion 6, 2026-11-05)
The rules register of krizaka-agents (docs/rules-register.md, its org-rules table) names exactly the rules of this registry: the register and the matrix are the same list (founder 2026-11-06)
